findings.summary: The rule that the two Caddy sites never share an upstream is checked only on the default values, because the ports are locals and not variables, so a change that edited both locals together would pass.
The README step that validates the Caddyfile on the host (caddy validate run as the caddy user) has not been run on a host and is marked VERIFY.
The issue's start condition (#237's first deploy has run once) was waived by the maintainer on 2026-11-16 for building and merging; the apply of this change still waits for that deploy.
